page.overview:
Who is Alex Smutko?

Alex "Al" Smutko was a Starfleet officer who served during the mid-24th century.

In 2353, he was listed as a Starfleet Operational Support Services officer on a directory placard at Starbase 32, Maxia sector. His office was located in room #45241. (, directory)

In 2365, he was the commander of the . His name was listed on the Starship Deploy Status chart that was on display in the courtroom of Starbase 173. (, okudagram)

During the 2370s, he was listed as a yard engineer on the dedication plaques of the in 2371, and the in 2373. (, ; , )
